Name: Autoloader
Description: Picking up ammo, reloads current weapon beyond normal magazine capacity.

Name: Eezo-Infused Ammunition
Description: Your weapon hits have 15% chance of sending enemies flying

Name: Machine Spirit
Description: Defeating enemies with tech powers, has a 15% chance of spawning a powerful drone. Drones expire after 60 seconds. Max 3 drones can be active at the same time.

Name: Project Drones
Description: Your drones and turrets have greatly increased damage and health

Name: Upgraded Omnitool
Description: At the start of the round select one Tech Power. It's cooldown is reduced. Stacks.

Name: Masterpiece
Description:
At the start of the game select one of your weapons as your masterpiece. 
Masterpiece gains following bonuses:
- 50% Magazine Increase
- 15% Increased rate of fire
- 15% increased damage

Name: Super Suit
Description:
At the start of the game select one of following bonuses to your armor:
- Sprinting massively inceases your melee damage. Decays over 5 seconds after stopping.
- Dodging recharges portion of your shield
- Your weapons have zero recoil

Name: Jika-Tabi
Description: Sprinting for a short time, grants a drastic movement speed increased for 8 seconds

Name: Tactical Advantage
Description: Whenever your roll or enter cover, reduce your active cooldown.

Name: Ambush
Description: Deal 200% damage to enemies above 75% health.

Name: Single Out
Description: Gain increased melee damage against enemies who are more than x meters away from any other enemies

Name: Thrill of the hunt
Description: Enemies you hit with your powers, have their damage and speed reduced.

Name: Surprise Attack
Description: Emerging from cloak, staggers nearby enemies

Name: Impossible Target
Description: Entering cloak grants temporary invincibility. Killing a nearby enemy while this effect is active cloaks the player

Name: Primed for Takedown
Description: Enemies hit with your powers, take additional damage from all sources

Name: Advanced Decoy
Description: Dodging leaves behind an invulnerable, mobile decoy. Only one decoy can be active at a time. Expires after 15 seconds.

Name: Big Bada Boom
Description: Throwing a grenade, reloads your current weapon

Name: Bloody Mess
Description: Defeating enemies with grenades, triggers health regeneration

Name: Ammo Belt
Description: Your Assault Rifles have drastically increased magazine size

Name: Suppressive Fire!
Description: Continuously firing your weapon grants stacking damage reduction of 5% per second. Stacks 10 times.

Name: Special Sauce
Description: Your grenades have drastically increased damage.

Name: The Geneva What?
Description: All your Assault Rifles deal explosive damage
Comment: Expand on this, its not as exciting as other capstones. Maybe add something about killing multiple enemies in a short span of time (2-3 seconds) granting some huge bonus.

Name: Firmly Planted
Description: Your are immune to staggers while firing your weapon

Name: Bloodthirst
Description: Hitting enemies with your weapon regenerates a small amount of health

Name: Berserker Rage
Description: Deal increased damage while near maximum health, deal decreased damage while in cover

Name: Hair Trigger
Description: Heavy Pistol and SMG rate of fire is increased by 25%

Name: It's High Noon
Description: Hitting three different enemies with Heavy Pistols or SMGs in a short span of time, grants increased movement speed, and aim assist.
Comment:
Instead of this effect, lets try to replicate its high noon as an "ultimate" ability.

I think we can use SFXModule_AimAssist to maybe even get a High Noon-ish mechanic.

Name: Shoot from the hip
Description:
Your Heavy Pistols and SMGs have drastically decreased recoil when shot from the hip.
Aiming them reduces rate of fire, but increases precision damage.

Name: Love and Peace
Description: Dodging reloads your equipped Heavy Pistols and SMGs.

Name: Ryder's Party Trick
Description: Each time you use a Biotic Power, it changes to another Biotic power. Your cooldowns are greatly decreased.
Comment: It's a great idea, but it might be a problem to get the icons updated as well.

Name: Somewhat Unlimited Power
Description: Every second, gain 20% more power damage. Stacks up to 10 times. Stacks reset on power use.

Name: Stop Right There, Reaper Scum
Description: Hitting enemies with your powers, has 30% chance of putting them in Stasis.

Name: Mind Trick
Description: Your offensive powers have 10% chance to make the enemy fight for you

Name: Focused Mind
Description: Your cooldowns are drastically reduced while near full shield.

Name: Vampirism
Description: Using your powers on nearby enemies, recharges a small portion of your shields

Name: Deflect
Description: Incoming damage is also applied to nearby enemies

Name: Anomaly
Description: Using powers builds up Anomaly stacks. Upon reaching 7 stacks, your powers strike with more force, and apply Reave to enemies near target.

Name: No Man Left Behind
Description:
Damage resistance is greatly increased when reviving allies. 
This effect persists for 5 seconds after the revive, and is applied to the revived ally.
Reviving Allies takes less time.

Name: Natural Leader
Description: Your kills grant increased damage, reload speed and cooldown reduction to nearby allies

Name: Anti-Indoctrination
Description: Enemies remaining in your presence have an escalating chance of switching teams. Maximum 3 enemies.

Name: Platinum Bundle
Description: When receiving fatal damage, you are instead healed back to 25% life and gain a brief cloak. Can only occur once per round.

Name: Alliance Reinforcements
Description: Gain two permanent Alliance allies

Name: VIP Treatment
Description: Gain increased weapon damage and damage reduction for each ally in vicinity

Name: Bring It Down!
Description: Enemies targetted by your weapons take additional damage from all sources

Name: Personal Attention
Description:
At the start of each round select an ally to inspire. Inspired allies gain a boost to their statistics. 

Inspired ally gains and provides bonuses of VIP Treatment and Natural leader at any distance. <- TBC might be too complex

Name: Special Tactics
Description:
At the start of each round select one of 3 tactics for the team:
Fervour - Grants drastically increased health and movement speed to all allies.
Press the advantage- Whenever an ally gets a kill, they generate a portion of their ammo and grenades
Last Stand- Rate of Fire and reload speed are drastically increased while all allies stay together. Enemies in close range suffer additional damage.

Name: Outlaw
Description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

Name: In The Zone
Description: Chaining precision kills, increases your weapon damage by 50%. Stacks 10 times and resets after 7 seconds.

Name: Quigley's Bucket Trick
Description: Your precision hits, stagger enemies around the target.

Name: Controlled Breathing
Description: Aiming your weapon for a short time without firing, grants increased precision damage.

Name: There is wisdom in these walls
Description: Entering cover grants a brief period of increased precision damage

Name: Death from above
Description: Drastically increase damage inflicted on enemies at lower elevation

Name: Camping is a valid tactic
Description: If you haven't moved in the last  3 seconds, become cloaked. While cloaked and shortly after, your Sniper Rifles and semi-automatic Assault Rifles do not consume ammo.

Name: Steady Aim
Description: As long as there are no enemies nearby, gain moderate target acquisition

Name: Familiar Weight
Description: Your Sniper rifles and semi-automatic Assault Rifles, do not affect your power cooldowns

Name: Into the Fray
Description:
Killing nearby enemies grants stacks of Fury.
Fury stacks grant following bonuses: 
* 10% Damage Reduction
* 15% Melee Damage Increase
At Max Fury Stacks, your Melee Attacks stagger enemies. Weaker enemies are killed on hit.

Name: Whips and Chains Excite Me
Description: Melee and Power damage is greatly increased while shield is broken.

Name: The Rorshach Test
Description: Each nearby enemy increases power damage by 20%

Name: Thermaly Conductive Fists
Description: Hitting an enemy with melee partially reloads your equipped weapon.
